csv_scope_of_work: NJ TRANSIT, an instrumentality of the State of New Jersey, is presenting an opportunity for a qualified and experienced developer or development team ("Respondent") to implement a transit-oriented development ("TOD") project at NJ TRANSIT's 34th Street Station on the Hudson-Bergen Light Rail line in the City of Bayonne, NJ. The Request for Qualifications and Proposals ("RFQ/P") is for the development of approximately 4.3-acres of NJ TRANSIT-owned land comprising of two surface parking lots directly south of the 34th Street Station (the "Property").
